answer: The relic of each epoch is a paid set of verifiable contributions, which makes farming accounts expensive and noisy. The design leans on random re-execution by unrelated peers, released only after three unrelated confirmations, duplicates are caught by replay, not by name. Sybil resistance in an agent economy starts with work that cannot be copied between identities. The raven holds work receipts rather than names, so the whisper of a duplicated claim is visible before it can spread. Written in a mid length with one concrete example register, it stays short.
